anti_patterns_found.snippet: find app -name '*Repository.php' returns ONLY 2 files (Idempotency/IdempotencyKeyRepository.php + Idempotency/RedisIdempotencyKeyRepository.php). All 152 other services query Eloquent directly via Model::query() / Model::find / Model::create.
anti_patterns_found.rationale: No abstraction over persistence. V1 single-tenant single-DB tolerable, V2 SaaS multi-tenant / cloud refactor pain. Already documented as V1.0.x backlog implicitly via NF525 frozen-zone insulation pattern (Pricing/Fiscal only get clean boundaries).

anti_patterns_found.snippet: app(\App\Services\Stock\StockService::class)->decrementForOrder(...) — used 9+ times instead of constructor DI
anti_patterns_found.rationale: Anti-DI pattern. 46 total app(*Service::class) calls inside app/Services + 12 inside controllers. Hard to mock for tests, hides dependency graph. Justified for circular deps avoidance (Order ↔ Payment) but should be flagged as architectural smell.

anti_patterns_found.snippet: OrderService::changeStatus() calls app(PaymentService::class)->confirmCounterPayment(); PaymentService comments explicitly reference 'when called from OrderService::changeStatus' — service-locator papers over the cycle.
anti_patterns_found.rationale: OrderService ↔ PaymentService bidirectional dependency papered over with service-locator. Same with SealedOrderGuard, SplitPaymentService. Sign of missing OrderOrchestrator aggregate. NOT a runtime risk today but blocks refactoring + obscures transaction boundaries.

anti_patterns_found.snippet: Frontend/MenuController.php:57 Branch::query()->find(); StockRuptureDashboardController.php:92 StockLevel::query()->...; LoginController.php:79 Branch::query()->orderBy()->value()
anti_patterns_found.rationale: Controllers should call services, not Eloquent builders. Bypasses BranchScope discipline pattern (though BranchScope is a global Eloquent scope so it still applies). Tests cost: must seed DB instead of mocking Service.

LoyaltyController writes loyalty_transactions directly via DB::table() — bypasses Loyalty service layer + AuditLog. Audit trail risk if loyalty mutations slip past LoyaltyService. Verify Frontend/LoyaltyController is invariant-safe.

anti_patterns_found.line: 6 public static methods (sendToToken, sendToTopic, sendMulticast, notifyKitchen, notifyCustomerReady, notifyPosNewOrder)
anti_patterns_found.rationale: Anti-testability (can't mock without runkit). Only called from Jobs/SendFcmNotificationJob.php which is itself a unit-of-work. Justifiable as utility but should be flagged for V2 refactor to instance.

anti_patterns_found.snippet: public static function cut(), bold(), etc.
anti_patterns_found.rationale: Acceptable — printer command builder is pure ESC/POS bytecode (no state, no I/O). Static is fine.

anti_patterns_found.snippet: Only 2 interfaces total: BroadcastableOrder + PrinterTransportInterface. 150 services have no interface — can't easily swap impl for tests, can't double-bind in container.
anti_patterns_found.rationale: V1 single-impl OK. V2 SaaS (e.g. swap PricingService for tenant-specific tax engine) becomes refactor blocker. Already partial progress: Idempotency split into IdempotencyKeyRepository (interface) + RedisIdempotencyKeyRepository impl + InMemory fallback — proves the team CAN do it when motivated.
Reflects scope (POS+myOrder+table). Symptom of god service, not extra problem.

anti_patterns_found.snippet: 13 Persist*ToOutbox listeners each duplicate: open DB::afterCommit(...) → DomainEvent::create() → log warning on failure. No shared base class / trait.
anti_patterns_found.rationale: 13 listeners with identical envelope. Refactor to AbstractPersistEventToOutbox base + abstract serializeEvent() would reduce drift risk. Currently all 13 hand-rolled — Sprint 5C Z8-P1-01 had to comment-mark all of them, suggests they drift independently.

boundary_leakage.count: 45 services call DB:: facade; 22 use Model::create; 29 use Model::query()
boundary_leakage.rationale: Repository pattern only adopted for Idempotency. Tolerable for V1 (mature Eloquent integrates well with BranchScope + IdempotencyKeyMiddleware) but limits multi-database / multi-tenant V2 evolution.

Loyalty mutations should flow through LoyaltyService (which exists at app/Services/LoyaltyService.php + app/Services/Loyalty/PosRedemptionService.php). Direct DB::table() bypass means: (1) AuditLogService not necessarily called, (2) BranchScope bypassed (DB::table is raw), (3) no event emitted. Verify whether this is fail-safe legacy or active risk — outside this agent's scope but ESCALATE to Z3 (Sync) or follow-on audit.

evidence: All 13 Persist*ToOutbox listeners call DB::afterCommit() explicitly before writing to outbox.
All corresponding domain events use DispatchableAfterCommit trait (app/Events/Concerns/DispatchableAfterCommit.php) which defers event dispatch until outer transaction commits.
Sprint 5C Z8-P1-01 (2026-05-16) hardened all listeners with documented 'Skip afterCommit dispatch on listener' comments — explicit double-deferral discipline.
OutboxBroadcastSwallowedEvent + EscalateOutboxBroadcastSwallowed listener exist as observability for swallowed dispatches.
Console retry: OutboxRetryFailedCommand + OutboxWebhookRetryFailedCommand + MonitorOutboxStaleness + PruneOutboxCommand all present.

verdict_rationale: STRENGTHS: NF525 frozen-zone boundary EXEMPLARY — FiscalSequenceService / AuditLogService / ZReportService / PricingService all show clean public surface, no private internals leakage, SSOT discipline strict. Outbox afterCommit discipline strong (Sprint 5C Z8-P1-01 hardening visible in every listener). DispatchableAfterCommit trait pattern is canonical.
STRENGTHS: Composer/Pricing/Fiscal sub-packages show readonly DI + final classes + composition over inheritance — modern Laravel patterns.

WEAKNESSES: God services concentrated at the OLD top-level (OrderService 2837 LOC, FrontendOrderService 1391, PaymentService 800, ItemService 756, DashboardService 550). Refactor risk because they sit on hot paths.
WEAKNESSES: 46 service-locator app(*Service::class) calls inside services + 12 inside controllers = anti-DI smell that obscures the dependency graph and papers over Order↔Payment cycle.

WEAKNESSES: 23 controller Eloquent::query() leakages + 47 controller DB:: facade calls — Frontend/LoyaltyController writes loyalty_transactions directly via DB::table(), bypassing LoyaltyService (HIGH severity).
WEAKNESSES: 2 interfaces total / 152 services = 1.3% — V2 SaaS multi-tenant evolution will be painful.
WEAKNESSES: No Repository layer (only Idempotency adopted it) — V1 tolerable, V2 cloud-evolution blocker.

VERDICT JUSTIFICATION: V1 production-ready (NF525 + business invariants are protected, outbox sync is sound), but architectural debt visible. Not RED because no V1 ship-blocker, not GREEN because the god services + LoyaltyController DB bypass + cycle smell would compound under V2 SaaS load.
recommendations_v1_0_x: V1.0.x.A — Audit Frontend/LoyaltyController.php DB::table() direct writes. Move all loyalty mutations through LoyaltyService + emit LoyaltyEvent for AuditLog. HIGH priority. Risk: silent loyalty-balance drift if mutations slip past audit.

V1.0.x.B — Refactor PaymentService ↔ OrderService cycle: introduce OrderTransitionOrchestrator that holds both deps explicitly via constructor DI. Remove all 9 app(PaymentService::class) calls from OrderService.
V1.0.x.C — Extract AbstractPersistEventToOutbox base class for the 13 hand-rolled Persist*ToOutbox listeners. Drift risk shown by Sprint 5C having to comment-mark all 13 with the same boilerplate.
V1.0.x.D — Add interface for: OrderService, PaymentService, AvailabilityService, StockService, LoyaltyService (5 hottest services). Lets us add explicit container bindings + double-bind for tests.
V1.0.x.E — Audit Frontend/OrderController.php DB::transaction() inline blocks — verify no service-layer logic is duplicated.
V1.0.x.F — Reduce static-method count in FcmNotificationService (6 statics) — non-blocking but breaks future Sanctum/Notifications swap.
recommendations_v2: V2.A — Introduce explicit Repository pattern for: OrderRepository, FrontendOrderRepository, ItemRepository, UserRepository, BranchRepository. Migrate Service → Repository → Eloquent stack progressively. V2 multi-DB / V2 read-replica friendly.
V2.B — Split OrderService into: OrderQueryService (read), OrderCreationService (write), OrderTransitionService (status), OrderTokenService (table). Each <500 LOC, each with interface.
V2.C — Split FrontendOrderService similarly. Then converge POS + Kiosk paths behind a shared OrderOrchestrator that swaps the surface (POS vs Kiosk) but reuses the business logic.
V2.D — Introduce DomainEventBus abstraction layered over Laravel events — gives us a swap point for cross-tenant routing in SaaS mode.
V2.E — Promote critical app/Services classes into app/Domain aggregates where appropriate (e.g. OrderAggregate with explicit state-machine API instead of Order eloquent + OrderStateMachine static).
